name: Storm Titan
primary:
A giant storm titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either casts chain lightning through up to 3 foes: damage 4 ❤ lightning (×2 on wet), charge 40;
or slams the ground with both fists, which calls a lightning bolt; everyone within 5 blocks takes 3 ❤ lightning and charge 60.
self_description:
